description:
Time-range-archive simulation: one Basic.Energy/OperatingFacility with three
Consumer and two Producer metering points, a quarter-hour TimeRangeArchive
with three chained RollupArchives on top (hourly -> daily -> calendar month),
and the pipeline that generates a synthetic load profile across all of them.

The reference workload for validating time-range archives, chained rollups
and resolution-aware series queries without real meter data.

Prerequisites on the tenant: Communication enabled (supplies the Mesh Adapter
this blueprint targets) and Stream Data enabled.

TWO STEPS ARE NOT PART OF THE BLUEPRINT - a blueprint seeds entities, it does
not drive lifecycle:

  1) Activate the four archives IN ORDER - a chained rollup needs its source
     activated first, and activation is what provisions the per-archive
     CrateDB table:
       octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id ab0000000000000000000015   # PT15M source
       octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id ab00000000000000000001a0   # hourly
       octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id ab00000000000000000001b0   # daily
       octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id ab00000000000000000001c0   # monthly
  2) Deploy the DataFlow, then run the simulation:
       octo-cli -c ExecutePipeline --identifier cc00000000000000000000e2

Demo and training tenants only.
